mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish. Overcast skies hang over the Verona Public Library with temperatures at 20 degrees, feeling like 13 degrees. Note that while the ISS passes overhead tonight, you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

In city news, property tax bills will be mailed out by December 15th. The first installment is due January 31st to the City Treasurer, and the second is due July 31st to Dane County. Payments can be made by mail, online, in person, or via the 24 seven drop boxes at City Center. If you qualify for the lottery credit, make sure your application form is submitted by January 30th.

Looking at local events, you can test your knowledge with trivia happening today at Hop Haus Brewing Company, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's. Happening tomorrow, enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, and trivia at The Bogey Factory.

In the weekly police recap, on Monday, November 9th, an officer pulled over a swerving vehicle on Highway 18 151. The driver was arrested for a third offence O W I and cited for open intoxicants in the vehicle.
If you are craving a sweet treat, Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM. Today's flavor of the day is OREO REESE'S Cheesecake.
